question: In Small Cell Lung trials, classify the ICI by target class from its generic name as PD-1, PD-L1, or CTLA-4.
generated_sql:
SELECT
    "Name of ICI",
    CASE
        WHEN "Name of ICI" LIKE '%nivolumab%' OR "Name of ICI" LIKE '%pembrolizumab%' OR "Name of ICI" LIKE '%cemiplimab%' OR "Name of ICI" LIKE '%dostarlimab%' THEN 'PD-1'
        WHEN "Name of ICI" LIKE '%atezolizumab%' OR "Name of ICI" LIKE '%durvalumab%' OR "Name of ICI" LIKE '%avelumab%' THEN 'PD-L1'
        WHEN "Name of ICI" LIKE '%ipilimumab%' THEN 'CTLA-4'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS "ICI Target Class"
FROM compat.clinical_trials
WHERE "Cancer type" = 'Small Cell Lung'
GROUP BY "Name of ICI"
